t:
Allods Online team apologizes for the inconvenience and offers you the following compensation: 24 Carnival Masks to adjust your body type in the Hall of Changes!

Enjoy the game!

Allods Online team apologizes for the inconvenience and offers you the compensation. Game currency for all missing items is fully recompensed. Open the Valuables tab of your character screen.

Enjoy the game!

All artifacts owned by you were removed due to the installation of the latest upgrade. You will find compensation attached to this letter. Enjoy the game!

Best regards, Allods Online Team.
Due to significant changes in game mechanics, some items have obtained new properties. This letter contains information about modified items. The Game Masters wish you a good game!

The Light is pouring gifts upon all the Sarnaut people! Let this reward strengthen your will and boost your power! Log in every day for 7 days and receive one of our gorgeous costumes! For those who would enter each day for 28 days, the Light has saved a special prize: an Insense Kit150 Glowing Tears of the Dragon!

Greetings!

A special shipment of goods has been delivered to the Boutique, and I'm ready to offer them to the heroes of Sarnaut. And at a discount, yes!

To make sure I'm dealing with a real hero and not some crooks, I will offer it only if you have a special coupon (one of them is attached to this message).

This coupon was created using cutting-edge technomagic, so you can pick it up in any reflection of Sarnaut with any of your Incarnations. But only once, yes!

Dear player!

Your completed Dionic Games quests have been automatically closed.

This message has a reward attached to it that corresponds to the medal received for the trial.

The Administration apologizes for the inconvenience caused. Enjoy the game!

Please stop! Or do you take pleasure in killing the innocent?
We, Mountainfolk of Coldberg, promise not to attack the free traders any more. Just spare us a scrap of land at least. Give us a chance to survive!

Your boldness has impressed us greatly. You are so brave, so pitiless to kill our family... We can tell you how aroused it has some of us!
Your admirers here have decided to give you a present. A gift. Appreciate our generosity!
If you ever return, you will surely feel the full power of our bloody love. We are going to kiss you to death, hug you to suffocation. Do come back, I'll be waiting.

Damn you! Murderer of the Enlightened

and Knowledgeable! Traitor of Great Truth, that you don't even deserve to know!

 Remember, your mane is in the Black Bloody List. Your future is predetermined. It will be not long and very painful.

 We'll take care of it!  Those poor that you kill usually ask for mercy and offer you a bribe. We also send you money. 30 pieces of silver. And that's not a pay for forgiveness. Buy a shroud, Doomed!

Damn you! Murderer of the Enlightened and Knowledgeable!

Traitor of Great Truth, that you don't even deserve to know!

Remember, your mane is in the Black Bloody List. Your future is predetermined. It will be not long and very painful.

 We'll take care of it!  Those poor that you kill usually ask for mercy and offer you a bribe. We also send you money. 30 pieces of silver. And that's not a pay for forgiveness. Buy a shroud, Doomed!

There's nothing better than giving a gift. Particularly to someone that's earned it.
By participating in the race you've made a priceless contribution to science and have earned a great prize.

The letter looks weird. It's not just a letter but an appliqué of harpies' feathers. It's impossible to understand what is written here.

However, the attached gold makes me think that dark harpies living in sands of ZIT archipelago ask for mercy thereby...

Hey! Stop killing us! We respect you alright! Enough with it, ok?

And tell Clan of Fighters that we won't hit them anymore. They had to tell that you are their friend. We wouldn't have hit them.

Gold that we send is yours. Just a present.

So? Is everything settled?

Just like water wears away the stone, your hatred of our people broke our spirit.

We promise not to put obstacles to the hairy creatures that have landed in Quiet Harbor.

The letter looks weird. It's not just a letter but a pattern made of... fish scales. No, lamia scales!

The attached gold makes me think that lamias of Tenebra ask for mercy thereby. Turns out they arn't so cold-blooded after all...

Aho, friend!

My name is Diana, but my friends call me Gadget.

I heard you ownown armor. You can now buy mana batteries, emergency kits and memory modules from me and not from my fellow countryman Gaal-Bran the GloomySlap the Furious.

I'm also an expert in improving combat mechanisms. I will make your armor even more powerful.

Come! I'll be waiting.

R-r-r! At first we just wanted to kill you. Then kill you several times. Then kill you forever!

Now we want you to leave us alone. Live and let others live!

This gold is yours. Hope, it's enough for you to buy the ticket to the ship. So you can go somewhere and we will never meet again. R-r-r!

Hey! Let's be friends!

So: you don't interfere in our business and don't interfere in yours. Aha?

Look, we are so kind. We give you gold.

Agreed?

There is nothing more pleasant than giving presents. Especially if they are deserved.
The prize you are receiving from me is a proof of your glory and acknowledgment of your efforts. The Kirah Race Managers are gone and cannot fulfill their promise and reward you for your victory. I am doing it for them instead.
Director.

Hey, Red! Stop this! If you are strong it doesn't mean to beat us all senseless!

Let's be friends! As a sign of our kind intentions we send you a small gift. We, Blues, are for the peace!

The letter looks odd. It's not just a letter but three shells!

It appears that the lizardmen of Dead Sea attached some gold along with the message! It must be their way of asking for mercy. Curious though, they can't wright yet they understand the value of gold.

Oh, great, mighty, and terrific waterfolk destroyer! Please don't punish us anymore! We promise to no longer poach on the Vertush.

We pray to the cold water, that we never see you again.

We, the rebels of Darkwater, appeal to you to stop the senseless violence. In exchange, we promise to allow people safe passage through Darkwater. This has been a great wake up call for us and we're calling for a truce! Enough bloodshed!
